claim_label: SMAClite-paper CPU EPyMARL-lineage reproduction on the current pinned v2 stack

amendments.reason: The paper states that every training run used CPUs and one CPU core. The v2 draft used a CUDA learner for convenience; v3 restores the disclosed device protocol and reserves CUDA for a separately labelled engineering profile.

Independent audit found that Section 5.2 selected-single-model values are not comparable to a five-training-seed aggregate. The numeric descriptive gate was removed and source/artifact integrity was hardened before launch.

claim_exclusions: not a bitwise reproduction of the unpublished 2023 training stack
not an algorithm-original PyMARL QMIX or VDN run
not an algorithm-original marlbenchmark/on-policy MAPPO run
not a reproduction claim when any protocol override is used

smaclite_python_rvo2.build_note: The patch changes build-system arguments and library paths only; the tracked upstream checkout is restored clean after producing the binary.

windows_compatibility_overlay.capture_reason: EPyMARL overrides Sacred's Windows-safe default with fd capture; sys capture avoids a pre-command deadlock under nested PowerShell and does not change the learner or environment.

reference_comparison.aggregate: arithmetic mean of one final evaluation mean from each of the five preregistered seeds
